Name: Less Claustrophobic Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations
Author: DraconisLeonidas
Description:
I completely adore the Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations mod by inmognito, but the layout inside has always felt insanely claustrophobic to me, not just due to the clutter, but also due to barely having room around the sides of the crop plot. You can manually replace the map with some work, but existing greenhouse map mods tend to be, well, bigger, for likely obvious reasons.

This was a nightmare to do. Replacing a Solid Foundations map is a bit different than replacing a regular map, and I'm not the most knowledgeable modder to begin with, so this probably took a lot longer than it should have. Still, here it is.

Installing is simple as usual. Download, unzip into your mods folder, and have fun. Make sure to clear out your Tiny Greenhouse(s) if you have some already, as everything will likely get displaced.
